lens: Independent recruiter scanning usefulness and full-viewport visual craft
scope: Frozen iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5 Debug synthetic Sessions and People retrieval views. All ten uncropped screenshots were inspected, including shell chrome. No previous review or plan was read.

category_breakdown.rationale: In compact views the session topic or person name is the first content read, context is complete, and review attention is a separate text-and-color signal. The filter scope and count are explicit. AX5 remains readable, but the fixed utility stack takes attention and viewport space away from the record; the visual meaning of unread elevation is implicit.

deductions.observation: The result count and Synthetic preview remain two large separate lines above the list even in both scrolled captures. Together with fixed navigation/search and the composer, this delays the next identity or operational status.
deductions.classification: Observed layout; the resulting scanning cost is a supported workflow inference.

deductions.observation: Unread is represented by the elevated/filled row surface and weight, without a visible Unread label. The input establishes its meaning, but a recruiter seeing one still state could also read that surface as selection. Review needed is much more self-explanatory.
deductions.classification: Observed visual encoding; ambiguity to an unfamiliar user is an inference, not a demonstrated error.

category_breakdown.rationale: Names, topics, role context and time remain legible; no essential text is ellipsized in the compact states. AX5 respects large readable text and exposes continuation through scrolling. The long context join has one avoidable line-break rough edge.

deductions.observation: The dot after Leila Hartmann sits at the end of the name line while Chief Product Officer search occupies following lines. The inline separator is less useful once the context has become a vertical block.
deductions.classification: Observed line break; minor typography refinement.

category_breakdown.rationale: Compact rows have steady insets, credible grouping, and honest sparse space. AX5 People introduces an additional leading avatar/menu band before the name, which makes a single record feel less compactly grouped.

deductions.observation: At AX5 the initials and menu occupy a separate band above Leila Hartmann, whereas at compact size the initials sit beside the identity. The first name begins below that band; the scrolled capture exposes the next initials/menu band before the next person name. This is valid scrolling, but the redundant initials band adds a step to visually locating the name.
deductions.classification: Observed grouping; supported inference about scanning effort. The partially visible next row is not counted as clipping or data loss.

category_breakdown.rationale: Warm neutral surfaces, sparse icons, flat read rows, and selective unread elevation are restrained. The persistent composer is the one shell element with more material emphasis than this retrieval task needs.

deductions.observation: The full-width pale pink Ask anything capsule carries a broad diffuse shadow in every light view. It draws a second elevated focus at the bottom of the screen, including states whose immediate job is opening an existing record.
deductions.classification: Observed material treatment; subjective craft preference within the frozen retrieval scenario.

category_breakdown.rationale: Sessions and People share search/filter placement, navigation, count/provenance treatment, and menu placement. The active People filter is visible and removable. Light/dark versions preserve identities and distinctions, and the AX5 follow-on views demonstrate a coherent scrollable layout. No additional independent deduction is warranted here; the explicit-unread and AX5-space refinements are already charged above.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Reduce avoidable AX5 utility and identity overhead while retaining the chosen readable text size, retrieval controls and synthetic disclosure: consider allowing the count/disclosure area to scroll, placing the People menu with the first name line, omitting redundant initials at this size, and separating multiline session name/context without a trailing dot.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: Repeat all four uncropped AX5 captures and reported navigation/restoration checks; complete labels and at least 44-point commands must remain reachable. Compare how much identity and state is available before each scroll.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Make the visual unread convention self-explanatory with a concise state cue integrated into existing metadata, preserving Review needed as an independent status and avoiding additional decoration.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: In a five-second scan, ask users to identify unread separately from review attention in both themes without explaining the card treatment; keep the reported independent read-state policy checks passing.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Quiet the persistent light-mode composer by reducing its diffuse shadow/material emphasis while retaining the command and its touch targets.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: Compare uncropped light views at compact and AX5 sizes; the record content should remain the first focus and the composer must remain easy to find.

functional_gate_evidence.reported_passes: review-input.md reports 3 focused policy tests, 8 distinct native UI checks, search/filter/reset and read-state composition checks, final long-list restoration/compact People search/Chinese dark AX5 reduced-motion reruns, and a hittable first-person AX5 menu of at least 44 by 44 points.
functional_gate_evidence.reported_cua: The input reports Read session versus Unread, Review needed, full identity/context labels, explicit menu commands, and Scroll Down reaching the next record.
functional_gate_evidence.independent_verification: This reviewer inspected still screenshots only and did not open test bundles, run UI control, inspect source, or re-execute behavioral checks.
functional_gate_evidence.limits: The stills do not certify tap targets, search/reset behavior, full accessibility, persistence, identity/provenance integrity or absence of external writes. Those rely on the supplied behavioral summary and scope statement. No functional gate is promoted from a visual score.

calibration: This is a subjective craft score, not a human preference measurement or an average of reviewers. Sparse blank space and legitimate large-type scrolling receive no deduction. Partial rows at scroll boundaries are not treated as clipped exports. No field-usefulness claim is made.
